title: Normalize cross-SDK handshake surface, graceful reconnects, and coordinated backoff (py/ts/go) + version bumps
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Users saw inconsistent reconnect behavior and token-refresh races across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs leading to duplicated requests and surprising errors during streaming sessions. This PR aligns the public handshake and reconnect ergonomics across the three SDKs, consolidates retry/backoff semantics, and bumps Go/TS/Py SDK semver to reflect the interoperability changes. Changes include: 1) explicit client->server handshake exchange with deterministic session ids and versioned capability flags; 2) a small client-side reconnect coordinator that deduplicates inflight resume attempts and uses a jittered exponential backoff with cap; 3) token refresh hook normalization so SDKs emit the same lifecycle events and allow user-supplied refresh handlers to run synchronously before reconnect; 4) updated streaming iterator/async iterable ergonomics and documented resume() call semantics; 5) matching CLI and examples for go/ts/py and a coordinated minor version bump across packages. Backwards compatibility: handshake includes a compatibility flag and falls back to legacy flow when server advertises older protocol; token refresh surfaces are additive so existing integrations will continue to work but may opt into the new coordinator for improved robustness. Testing: unit and integration tests added for reconnect dedupe, token refresh race windows, and resume semantics; end-to-end smoke runs against staging streaming gateway. Rollout: merged behind a runtime feature flag for 48h gradual traffic ramp, plus a Canary for Dedicated customers. See release notes for user-facing migration steps and examples.
commits_summary: Initial implementation of handshake and coordinator; add Go coordinator and tests; mirror changes in TypeScript client and update async iterator; python: expose new on_refresh hook and test resume; docs and examples for resume semantics; bump versions (go v0.12.0, ts 1.5.0, py 0.9.3); fix lint and CI failures after cross-language refactor
file_snippets: // go/sdk/stream/coordinator.go: dedupe inflight resume requests with a singleflight-like map and jittered backoff
// ts/sdk/stream/resume-iterator.ts: expose resume() that returns a Promise resolved when session resumed
release_notes: Fix: Stream reconnects deduplicated and more resilient to auth refresh races. Improvement: Unified handshake protocol across SDKs. Breaking: None if using default behaviors; see migration notes for custom token refresh handlers.
review_comments: Daniel Park: High level LGTM. Please add an explicit test for two concurrent refresh handlers racing to reconnect.
Riley Chen: Suggest moving the jitter config to client options; avoids magic numbers and helps Dedicated customers tune behavior.
Sofia Martinez: Docs look good, add an example showing manual resume() after a transient network partition.
Asha Kapoor (author): Added the concurrent refresh test and exposed backoff params as ClientOptions. Updated docs with manual resume example and bump script. CI rerun is green.
notes_for_backports: Backport to release/1.5.x only if customers on that branch report streaming reconnect regressions; prefer patches that add coordinator toggles behind runtime flag.
changelog_snippet: Unify SDK handshake and streaming reconnect semantics across Go/TS/Py; improve token refresh resilience; bump SDK versions.
